build_CLIPGenerator: build a CLIPGenerator module to extract features and attention from the last layer of CLIP
build_MILANViT: build a MILANViT Vision Transformer encoder that replaces random masking with attention masking for MILAN pre-training
build_MILAN: build a MILAN self-supervised model for masked image pretraining on language assisted representation
test_attention_masking: test the MILANViT attention_masking method to generate attention masks based on patch importance scores
test_MILAN_loss: test the MILAN loss function to compute loss between predicted and CLIP target features
